No, I do not believe that we should “surrender human free will” to AI systems, and it’s absurd to suggest that I do. I have written hundreds of pages of essays and a constant theme in them is the need for AI to be governed by legitimate democratic processes. For millennia (going all the way back to Greek and Roman philosophers), advocates of autocracy have claimed that it leads to better, faster, or more decisive decision-making than the messy process of democracy. Even if this were true (which I doubt!), we should never sacrifice legitimacy or self-determination at the altar of efficiency or security. This argument against autocracy applies word for word against governance by AI, and I feel equally strongly that turning over governance to AI is a bad idea.

No one who had carefully read my writing or my interviews could reasonably conclude that I believe anything different. For example ......

加州基本不存在“竞业协议”这回事：按 B&P Code §16600，任何限制人从事合法职业的合同条款直接无效 [[2]](https://leginfo.legislature.ca.gov/faces/codes_displaySection.xhtml?lawCode=BPC&sectionNum=16600.5)，2024 年新法还让它变得极其严格：
• **SB 699**（2024/1/1 生效）新增 §16600.5：无效的竞业条款**不管在哪签、什么时候签，都不可执行**；雇主连“签”或“试图执行”都算违法，员工可起诉要禁令、赔偿和律师费，还能按 UCL 追责 [[4]](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/01/alerts-practices-tsemnc-new-laws-reinforce-californias-hostility-to-non-competes-with-notice)
• **AB 1076**：要求雇主在 2024/2/14 前书面通知 2022/1/1 之后任职的员工“你的竞业条款无效”，漏发或发错每次罚 2500 美元 [[4]](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/01/alerts-practices-tsemnc-new-laws-reinforce-californias-hostility-to-non-competes-with-notice)
• 例外只剩卖公司场景：出售全部或实质全部股权（§16601）、合伙解散（§16602）、LLC 权益转让（§16602.5）[[4]](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/01/alerts-practices-tsemnc-new-laws-reinforce-californias-hostility-to-non-competes-with-notice)
• 客户“不挖角”条款在加州也常被判无效（AMN Healthcare v. Aya, 2018），员工不挖角条款目前还在打官司 [[4]](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/01/alerts-practices-tsemnc-new-laws-reinforce-californias-hostility-to-non-competes-with-notice)
• 真正还能约束他们的是保密协议、IP 归属、股票 vesting 和商业秘密诉讼；竞业条款没有这些效力
所以 Thariq 从 Anthropic 去 OpenAI，法律上就是“拎包即走”，公司连拦的资格都没有；剩下的只是别把老东家的代码库背在包里。
